name: Architecture BRIO
description:
Architecture BRIO is an award-winning design practice with studios in Mumbai (India) and Rotterdam (the Netherlands). Since its founding, the firm has evolved into one of the most respected architecture and design practices in the country, led by Shefali Balwani (C.E.P.T, Ahmedabad) and Robert Verrijt (Technical University, Delft). Their international background and deep local insight inform a body of work that is both globally relevant and uniquely Indian.

From its base in Mumbai, the studio works across a wide range of projects - residences, public buildings, cultural spaces, and landscapes, balancing innovation with environmental responsibility.

owner_posts.post_text: Discover the Duplex Apartment in Mumbai, a sophisticated living space by Architecture BRIO. Among the best interior design firms Mumbai and one of the top interior firms in India, the firm combines contemporary design, innovation in spatial design, and refined materials, providing the urban dweller with stylish, comfortable, and functional living.

MiCabin is designed by Architecture BRIO and is located in the serene Himalayas in Uttarakhand. It is a remarkable property in hospitality architecture, showcasing the brilliance of pioneering hospitality architects in India. With a contemporary and minimalist design, and by integrating with the natural environment, MiCabin provides guests with soothing and relaxing views of the mountains and their glorious design. It, also, emphasizes the values of simplicity and sustainability.

Experience tranquility at a thoughtfully designed Yoga Retreat & Wellness Centre in Dharamshala, crafted by Architecture BRIO, renowned for excellence in hospitality architecture. Counted among leading hospitality architects in India, the project blends nature, mindfulness, and innovative design to create serene spaces for healing, relaxation, and holistic well-being.

At Cliffadel Housing Goa, you can experience contemporary and sustainable living designed by Architecture BRIO, recognized amongst the elite architects in India. The firm's approach creates an innovative blend of design and sustainability providing smart homes that consume minimal energy. Enjoy architecture that has been designed with an emphasis on improving the comfort, utility, and synergy with nature of each and every living space.

Spiral Dollhouse is a playful exploration of architecture at a miniature scale, designed as a spiralling spatial sequence that unfolds vertically through interconnected rooms and levels. Conceived as both an architectural model and a child’s play object, the project reimagines the dollhouse as a dynamic spatial journey—encouraging imagination, movement and curiosity through form, colour and carefully crafted details.

The Ekya IB School in Goa is envisioned as a contemporary learning environment set within a lush two-acre landscape overlooking paddy fields. Instead of conventional corridors, classrooms are organized around a series of micro-courtyards that encourage interaction, light and ventilation. Staggered volumes and open learning spaces create a dynamic campus that supports collaboration, exploration and a strong connection to nature.

Forest Eco Resort is conceived as a network of lightweight forest cabins immersed within a natural woodland setting. Positioned near streams and ponds that attract birds and arboreal wildlife, the cabins act as quiet observatories for nature. Designed with minimal ecological impact, the project promotes environmental awareness while allowing visitors to experience the forest landscape through intimate, immersive stays.

Tala Treehouse Villa is a forest retreat perched on a cliff within the lush Forest Hills landscape in Tala. Designed as an open, voluminous space beneath a thatched roof, the villa blends transparency, timber structure and operable glass to frame panoramic forest views. Fluid interiors, outdoor decks and a semi-open bathroom dissolve the boundary between architecture and the surrounding tropical wilderness.

House in The Palms reimagines an existing residence through strategic spatial restructuring and refined detailing. The design enhances natural light, visual flow and functional clarity while preserving the home’s character. Thoughtful material layering and custom interventions transform interiors into calm, purposeful spaces that enrich everyday living and deepen the connection between architecture, light, and context.

Urban Green Home is a duplex apartment in Juhu, Mumbai, anchored around a double-height internal courtyard that brings light, greenery and spatial connection into dense urban living. Thoughtful planning balances visual transparency with defined spaces, while floor-to-ceiling steel windows and layered interior zones create a fluid yet intimate home that blurs indoor and outdoor in the city.
